name: Slide markers
about: Speakers mark what goes on screen with "Slide", "Slide:", "Slide 1" or "SLIDE 4" lines, like "[slide]". Under each marker its words up to the next marker or empty line are one passage; a picture is its own; a line that is only a linked video file's name is a video slide waiting for its video, the link in its notes. A short line ending in a colon over a list ("Backyard Ultra - Rules:", "Cru's Four Root Idols:") is Points, the line its heading without the colon. The greeting before the first marker, the aside in parentheses, and the talk after a section's empty line never reach a slide. A one-line marker ("Slide 11: Welcome to Grace Church") makes a slide of its words, the label cut off; "Slide into the week with us." has no colon after the word and stays words.

runs.text: Hi team, here are my slides for Sunday.
Complete 4.167 miles, every hour, on the hour.
You win by being the last person standing.
What is it about prosperity that can cause us to forget God?
That's when I think about my grandfather's farm, and the summer the creek ran dry.
Slide into the week with us.
